task_definition.task_description: Please check out the silver Sony XM5 for me right away, then also prepare a recommended checkout for one black Sony XM5 in audio. After that, generate an invoice for that black pair and send it to alice@company.com via PayPal, then note the current UTC time and create an in-app medium-priority alert with the invoice payment message.
